findings.reason: §3's cite-or-justify list and §6's deletion/import census must bind polygon_moments.py (extend it as §3's moment owner, or retire it), or current.book becomes the third such implementation rather than the one.
findings.text: the plan's §3 "one booking" needs exact clip-to-cell polygon moments, which polygon_moments.polygon_monomial_moments/polygon_density_moments already implement, yet the plan names only clip_quadrature's private copy and never mentions polygon_moments.py at all, so a third moment implementation (separatrix_clip.py's _traced_polygon_moments:850 is the second) would survive the retirement the plan exists to achieve

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — each new owner is a single module exporting one entry point (§2 topology.read, §3 current.book, §4 gs.apply, §5 solve.fixed_point) hiding the field representation, the clip, the traced geometry operands and the Newton-GMRES kernel behind that one interface, replacing 54,102 lines spread across 54 files; the interface is smaller than what each hides.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §3 current.book adds the "one booking" over the read's membership but does not name nova/equilibrium/polygon_moments.py, which already owns generic polygon monomial and density moments (polygon_monomial_moments:141, polygon_density_moments:187) — the exact clip-to-cell-moment operation §3 needs; the plan binds only clip_quadrature.py's private _integrate_current_polynomial (clip_quadrature.py:635), so the codebase would carry a third moment implementation after §6.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every section that adds surface names what it retires or merges: §2 retires Topology.read/read_with_connectivity and carries TopologyPolicy inside the existing ForwardSolvePolicy; §3 retires clipped_support_current_moments and the forward_operator support partition; §4 retires the ForwardFluxOperator map; §5 retires newton_krylov/picard and carries SolvePolicy inside ForwardSolvePolicy; §6 supplies the module deletion list and an import census over the whole nova package.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan (and the design document it binds, docs/research/converged-forward-solve-design.html) searches the named codebase and cites the existing mechanisms it extends: Topology.read/read_with_connectivity (topology.py:1376,1396), clipped_support_current_moments (clip_quadrature.py:714), ForwardFluxOperator (forward_operator.py:2323), newton_krylov/picard (fixed_point.py:5003,2874), stencil_mesh.flux_field_polynomial (stencil_mesh.py:449), contour_tree.build_contour_tree, nova/biot/null.py, nova/biot/fieldnull.py, and the operand-identity flatteners (forward_operator.py:147,159,187). Nine recorded reuse rulings bind each candidate cite-or-justify. One mechanism is missed (see duplicate_owner).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — every section states that it replaces rather than wraps: §4 "replaces the map ForwardFluxOperator performs in forward_operator.py rather than wrapping it"; §5 "replaces newton_krylov, picard and operator_request_body"; §3 replaces clipped_support_current_moments; §2 replaces Topology.read and read_with_connectivity. The GMRES kernel (§5) and the quadrature helpers (§3) are carried as private helpers behind the new call site, not exposed as a parallel public layer, and each is bound to a cite-or-justify ruling.
